rationale: Both use F_{n+2} - F_n = F_{n+1} to rewrite each term as 1/F_n - 1/F_{n+2}, telescope the partial sum to 2 - 1/F_{N+1} - 1/F_{N+2}, and let N go to infinity to get 2. A works with partial sums from the start and writes out the first few terms, which makes it clear why exactly 1/F_1 + 1/F_2 and 1/F_{N+1} + 1/F_{N+2} survive. B first equates the infinite series with the telescoped infinite series, before any convergence argument, and then states the partial-sum result without showing the cancellation. A's presentation is a little more transparent and rigorous.
